Class DocumentTableModel

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.table.AbstractTableModel
be.henallux.project.view.DocumentTableModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, TableModel
public class DocumentTableModel extends AbstractTableModel
Table model used to display a list of Document in a JTable.

Provides column definitions and maps document attributes to table cells, including action columns for editing and deleting.

The model is read-only and must be refreshed using setDocuments(ArrayList) when the data changes.

    • getValueAt

      public Object getValueAt(int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
      Returns the value displayed in a specific table cell.

      The returned value is computed based on the column index and the corresponding Document located at the given row.

      Columns include:

      • Document identifier
      • Workflow label (or "N/A" if not available)
      • Date of creation
      • Send date if available, otherwise receipt date
      • Edit & Delete action label

      Date values are formatted for display using ViewUtils.formatDate(LocalDate). Missing workflow labels are replaced using ViewUtils.safeText(String, String).

      Parameters:
      rowIndex - the row index corresponding to a Document in the table model
      columnIndex - the column index defining which attribute of the document is displayed
      Returns:
      the formatted value to display in the table cell, or null if the column index is invalid
      See Also:
      • Document
      • ViewUtils.formatDate(LocalDate)
      • ViewUtils.safeText(String, String)
